ENVIRONMENT: InDesign_UXP_v18+ (TypeScript_ES2020, NOT ExtendScript, NOT Web DOM)

FRAMEWORK_INVARIANTS.BASE_CLASS: All domain services MUST extend BaseService<TOptions, TReport>
FRAMEWORK_INVARIANTS.TRANSACTION: Strictly synchronous inside process(). Handled by BaseService
FRAMEWORK_INVARIANTS.UNITS: Locked to POINTS and PAGE_ORIGIN automatically via BaseService
FRAMEWORK_INVARIANTS.DOM_MUTATION: Snapshot via .everyItem().getElements(); loop backwards if mutating items or replacing text/GREP
FRAMEWORK_INVARIANTS.ELEMENT_GUARD: Must check isElementEditable(item) before modifying contents/geometry/styles
FRAMEWORK_INVARIANTS.TEXT_LAYOUT: Always call doc.recompose() prior to inspecting .overflows or lines
FRAMEWORK_INVARIANTS.SELECTION: Always pass raw selection through SelectionResolver.resolve()
FRAMEWORK_INVARIANTS.PATHS: Use PathUtils for all path operations
